$comment: Application registry. The launcher resolves a menu tile's 'code' to an entry here, so
Menu Path's hardcoded http://localhost:876x/ URLs become internal routes on one origin.
ready    - converted to React and exercised end to end
scaffold - route exists and renders, conversion from the legacy HTML not finished
planned  - no application behind it yet (the launcher says so rather than failing silently)
'services' lists the config/services.json keys the app is permitted to call. The gateway
does not enforce this yet; it documents intent and drives the launcher's service badges.
'legacy' points at the HTML file the React app was converted from.

apps.title: FO: Create Master Contract
apps.note: Reads and writes ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON (MC number from middleware range ZSGTSFNR03/01) and ZSGTSFTR_MCCHILD through the SLC middleware; value helps from the ZSGTSFTR_* masters with the screen dummy kept for masters still empty in MySQL. The M.O. email is still only logged.

apps.title: MO: Confirm Master Contract
apps.note: Queue (ZMC_STAT 02/11) from ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON through the SLC middleware; Confirm -> 03, Reject -> 13, Edit writes the MC. Utilization needs ZSGTSFV_FX, which is not in MySQL.

apps.title: MO: Update MC Expiry
apps.note: Reads ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON through the SLC middleware and posts 04 -> 09 on expiry. Utilization needs ZSGTSFV_FX, which is not in MySQL.

apps.title: FO: MC Error Correction
apps.note: Correction queue (ZMC_STAT 11/21) from ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON through the SLC middleware; Update -> 13 / 22, Reverse -> 12. ZSGTSFV_MC and ZSGTSFV_FX are not in MySQL.

apps.title: MO: Reject MC after Expiry
apps.note: Reads ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON through the SLC middleware. Business partners and utilization need ZSGTSFV_FX, which is not in MySQL.

apps.title: Create Deal ID for Short Straddle Deals
apps.note: Short Straddle MCs from ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON and their Deal IDs from ZSGTSFTR_DEALID through the SLC middleware; Create Deal ID draws from range ZSGTSFNR01/01 and moves the MC to 04. Trader (AT100) and ZSGTSFV_FX amounts stay dummy.

apps.title: DE6: TSF FX Blotter
apps.note: Create Transaction, Create Spot, Auto Deal (both legs), Reverse and the initial load run against the FxTransaction OData service (ZFS_SB_TRMFX_O4_API, FTR BAPIs, general valuation class 0011). Product/transaction types follow the SAP value help (12A spot 600-609, 12B forward 619, 12D NDF 631/632). Entities, profit centres, business areas, FX models, commodities, Master Contracts and the MC tolerance load from the SLC middleware (comp, fxModel, commodity, masterContract, tolerance) and the screen shows an error rather than dummy data if they cannot. Group, trader, business partner, Release to MO, Deal IDs, Short Straddle and Upload are still dummy data in data.ts.

apps.title: EC2: TSF FO Error Correction - FX & Options
apps.note: FX half reads the FxTransaction service (names from comp, trmmaster and the business partner service; Deal ID and Master Contract from tsfDealId). Reverse = DELETE (BAPI_FTR_FXT_REVERSE); Correct = PATCH of rates, Amount 1, value date and trade date. SAP holds no Correction Required status, MO remark, trader, mode of trade, account category, business area, profit center or blotter date, so those are blank/read-only and every live row is Open. Options half is not wired (the options BAPIs are not in the service).

apps.title: FO: Change Deal ID
apps.note: Deal IDs (tsfDealId), their Master Contracts and the MC picker (masterContract, status 03/04, offered only under the deal's own FX model), the linked transactions (read live from the FxTransaction service, joined on company code + ZRFHA1-8; ZSGTSFV_FX is only the fallback for a leg the service does not return, and a live leg is Confirmed once SAP settled it, the MO screen's meaning of matched), the invoice plan (invRef), traders (trmTrader) and status texts (tsfDealStatus) are live. Change MC Ref No writes ZSGTSFTR_DEALID-ZMC_REF and Cancel Deal ID writes status 30; both stop at MySQL - the program's stamp on the Treasury transactions (BAPI_FTR_FXT_CHANGE) is not done. Change MC is refused while a leg's status cannot be read. Edit Deal Pair is not saved. Premium (ZSGTSFCDS_OPTION), strike and the planned P&L have no source and stay empty. No seed fallback.

apps.title: FO: Create Early Delivery/Unwinding/Rollover
apps.note: Reads SAP data only, via the middleware (api.ts): deal legs from ZSGTSFCDS_FX (tsfvFx), Txn Type from TVARVC ZSGTSFP_PRE_MATURE_EARLY_DDOWN, Bank BP from ZSGTRMTR_BP_GRP x ZSGTRMTR_BPEXT for the leg's ZGRP. WAITING FOR API: tsfvFx (ZSGTSFV_FX) lacks ZTSF_DEAL_ID and the VTBFHA extension fields and holds no rows; TVARVC has no rows for the variable; the three creates have no backend action.

apps.title: FO: Trader Workbench

Exercise/expire, NDF fixing and spot creation change the data in memory until Refresh. SAP wiring (ZSGTSFTR_DEALID, ZSGTSFCDS_FX/_OPTION, ZSGTSFTR_IN_SPOT, DEAL_ST, TRDWAI, TCURR, FxTransaction) is a follow-up.

apps.title: FO: Additional Spot Booking
apps.note: Create Spot books through FxTransaction (trmfx). Its drop-downs read SAP (valueHelps.ts): Company Code = A_CompanyCode limited to the TSF entities in ZSGTSFTR_COMP; Transaction Type = TransactionType under 12A/12B; Business Partner = SlcTsfBpBank for the picked company code, named from A_BusinessPartner. The deal rows are still the legacy seed data — no SAP entity serves the FX/DSS deal tables yet.

apps.title: AE1: TSF FO Error Correction - NDF Fixing
apps.note: Live, no sample data. Worklist = TrmFxApp TXN_STATUS 11 joined to FxTransaction; settlement currency from FxTransaction FollowCurrency. Update is disabled: TXN_STATUS 12 must go with the TX02 settle rate, and no service records a fixing rate yet.

apps.title: FO: Create Deal ID Manually
apps.note: Master Contracts (masterContract, status 03/04), existing Deal IDs (tsfDealId), traders (trmTrader), company-to-entity (comp) and the Treasury transactions for Deal 1 / Deal 2 (FxTransaction OData, minus those already on a Deal ID) are live. Create Deal ID draws the number from range ZSGTSFNR01/01, writes ZSGTSFTR_DEALID with both linked transactions and moves the MC to 04. NOT done: stamping the Deal ID onto the two Treasury transactions (BAPI_FTR_FXT_CHANGE) - the OData service has no field or action for it. Planned invoices, planned P&L and the FX Deal P&L row have no source yet (ZSGTSFTR_INV_REF is empty, ZSGTSFV_FX has no resource) and show empty; Change / Confirm, Edit Deal Pair and Premium Adjustment still change the screen only.

apps.title: TSF MO Deal Confirmation - FX & Options
apps.note: FX deals are read from the FxTransaction OData service (ZFS_SB_TRMFX_O4_API) and Match & Release settles them through its Settle action (BAPI_FTR_FXT_SETTLE); activity category 20 is Unmatched and 30 Matched & Released. Not covered by that service, so not saved: the External / Internal Ref and remark (BAPI_FTR_FXT_CHANGE) and Correction Required, which stays on this screen only. The Options rows are still dummy data; the options BAPIs are out of scope.

apps.title: TSF MO - Confirm NDF Fixing
apps.note: Live, no sample data. Queue = TrmFxApp TXN_STATUS 10 / 12 joined to FxTransaction (statuses from ZSGTSFTR_TXNSTAT type 01). Match & Release runs FxTransaction Settle (BAPI_FTR_FXT_SETTLE) then sets TXN_STATUS 13 + NDF_MO_REM; Correction Required sets TXN_STATUS 11 + NDF_MO_REM; the queue is re-read after each. Accounting from VTBFHAPO. NDF Value (ZCASH_AMT) has no service and shows a dash.

apps.title: UA1: TSF NDF Fixing
apps.note: Live, no sample data. Worklist = TSF append (TrmFxApp OData, ZSGTSFTR_APP_STR) in TXN_STATUS 07 joined to the FTR deal (FxTransaction OData) - NDF products only, reversed deals dropped; names / NDF date / ref from ZSGTSFV_FX (middleware tsfvFx), traders from ZSGTRMTR_TRD_GRP, status texts from ZSGTSFTR_TXNSTAT, RBI rate from TCURR, TCURF scaling. Save Fixing is disabled: it needs BAPI_FTR_FXT_NDF_FIXING + the TX02 settle rate, which no OData service exposes yet (a FixNdf action on ZFS_SD_TRMFX is proposed).

apps.title: MO: View List of Deal IDs for Confirmation
apps.note: ZSGTSF_RDEAL_LIST_CONF over the SLC middleware: ZSGTSFTR_DEALID at ZDEAL_STAT 01/02 joined to MAS_CON, COMP and DEAL_ST (FX1). Filters read SAP only: Region = COMP-ZREG_ID codes (no region text master is migrated), Origin Entity = ZSGTSFTR_COMP, FX Model = ZSGTSFTR_RULE_BT, Status = DEAL_ST FX1 <= 02. No sample fallback: an unreadable Deal ID table shows WAITING FOR DEAL ID API. Utilized Amt stays 0 until ZSGTSFCDS_FX / _OPTION carry ZTSF_DEAL_ID.

apps.title: TBB1 Posting - SAP Standard
apps.note: Treasury: Post Flows (RFTBBB00). Live, no sample data. Value helps from T001 (A_CompanyCode) and FTR customizing (trmmaster ProductType / TransactionType / FlowType). Execute reads VTBFHAPO (SBEWEBE 1, due date, company codes) with the FX deal header from FxTransaction and applies the remaining select-options. apps.title: FX NDF Settlement
apps.note: Live, no sample data. Worklist = TrmFxApp TXN_STATUS 13 joined to FxTransaction (12D, not reversed, value-date range). Letter address from the partner's Z002 address (API_BUSINESS_PARTNER); Preview and PDF build the letter in the browser. TBB1 Test / Post / Execute call FxTransaction PostSettlement (RFTBBB00) then set TXN_STATUS 50; NDF rate, cash amount and FI document come from FxTransaction fields. The action and fields are proposed in docs/abap/ZFS_SD_TRMFX-NdfSettlement.md and switch on when the service declares them. Letter account lines (VTBSTC1 / house bank) have no API.
